jobs.title: Information Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
Role purpose

The Information Security Project Manager is responsible for coordinating and driving the company’s information security activities in a pragmatic, commercially aware way.
This role exists to manage security-related projects, audits, and customer security interactions so that we stay compliant and credible without blocking sensible business decisions or over-engineering controls.

Scope and context

This role sits within the technology function and partners closely with Technical Operations, Engineering, Product, Legal, and Sales.
The focus is on governance, coordination, and communication
, not on dictating policy in isolation or acting as the final decision-maker on security matters.
Final risk and tooling decisions sit with the Director of Technical Operations and the broader leadership team; the Information Security Project Manager’s job is to provide clear input, well-reasoned recommendations, and organised execution.
We are a growing SaaS business without PCI, PHI, or highly sensitive PII in scope, and we are not subject to HIPAA or classified/secret information regime – our security approach should be proportionate: strong, credible, and well-documented, but not theatrical or unnecessarily restrictive.

Key responsibilities

ISO 27001 and internal audits

Plan, coordinate, and execute internal audits and control reviews against ISO 27001 (and related frameworks where relevant).
Maintain audit schedules, evidence repositories, and action logs so that we are consistently “audit ready” rather than scrambling before assessments.
Work with control owners across the business to ensure that required processes are in place, understood, and operating in a pragmatic way.
Track findings and remediation actions, ensuring owners are clear on what needs to be done and by when, and following up to completion.
Support external ISO 27001 surveillance and recertification audits, including planning, evidence collation, and managing auditor queries.

Security projects and initiatives

Coordinate discrete security improvement projects (for example, rolling out new security tooling, tightening access controls, or updating key policies).
Break down security initiatives into clear tasks, owners, and timelines, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.
Work with Technical Operations and Engineering to ensure technical changes are understood, documented, and reflected in our security posture.
Help prioritise security work by articulating risk, impact, and effort, while understanding the wider commercial and delivery context.

Customer security, RFPs and RFQs

Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success to respond to customer security questionnaires, RFPs, RFQs, and due diligence requests.
Maintain and continuously improve a central library of standard security responses and artefacts (for example, summaries of our controls, certifications, and processes).
Coordinate input from Technical Operations, Engineering, and Legal where deeper technical or contractual responses are required.
Attend customer calls when needed to explain our security posture in clear, non-alarmist language and build confidence in our approach.

Security information and communication

Develop and maintain a clear, concise view of our security posture that can be communicated internally and to customers (for example, how we handle data, access, monitoring, and incident response at a high level).
Ensure that key facts (such as use of encryption at rest and in transit, SSO capabilities, backup approaches, and incident processes) are understood and kept up to date, even if technical details are owned by others.
Translate technical explanations from engineers into language suitable for non-technical audiences, including customers and internal stakeholders.
Help ensure that security-related messages are proportionate, avoiding both complacency and unnecessary drama.

Policies, standards, and pragmatic governance

Maintain a focused, manageable set of security policies and procedures that reflect how we actually operate.
Work with policy owners to keep documents current, usable, and aligned to ISO 27001 and customer expectations, avoiding policy sprawl and unnecessary complexity.
Coordinate periodic reviews of key policies and standards, ensuring changes are communicated and understood.
Provide recommendations to the Director of Technical Operations on improvements to policies, controls, or tooling, with clear reasoning and trade-offs.

What this role is not

This is not a “head of security” or ultimate decision-maker role; final go/no-go and tooling decisions sit with the Director of Technical Operations and leadership.
This is not a role for writing endless policies or blocking change; it is about enabling sensible decisions with good information and structured follow-through.
This is not a hands-on security engineering or development role, though you will need enough technical understanding to ask good questions and interpret answers.
This is not an internal “police” function; success is based on collaboration, influence, and clarity, not on authority.

What You'll Bring To The Role

We’re looking for someone who brings most of the following:
3–5 years of experience in information security, compliance, risk, or IT audit within a SaaS or technology environment.
Hands-on experience with ISO 27001 (or similar frameworks), including audits, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.
Solid project management skills — planning, tracking progress, managing stakeholders, and communicating clearly.
Working knowledge of core security concepts such as encryption (at rest/in transit), access control, SSO/identity providers, backup and recovery, logging, and incident response — enough to discuss confidently and know when to bring in a specialist.
Comfortable engaging directly with customers and auditors, answering questions calmly and credibly.
Strong writing skills for policies, reports, and customer communications, paired with clear verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

Personal qualities

Pragmatic and commercially aware: able to distinguish between theoretical risk and real-world impact.
Collaborative, working with teams to find workable solutions rather than simply saying “no”.
Organised and methodical, keeping track of multiple audits, projects, and requests without dropping details.
Calm and credible under pressure, especially during audits, customer escalations, or security-related incidents.
Comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, and highlighting risk while still respecting broader business priorities.

Why this role matters

Done well, this role gives the business confidence that our security posture is robust, evidenced, and well-articulated, without turning security into a blocker for growth.
It ensures we meet our obligations to customers and auditors, support sales with clear and honest answers, and make security improvements in a deliberate, organised, and commercially sensible way.

Why us?

Perks & Benefits

Remote & flexible working – with hybrid options in London or Chichester
Fantastic team culture based on trust and belonging.
Laptop & home office budget – 500 EUR to set up your ideal workspace.
Private Medical Insurance with Aviva, including Dental & Optical.
Group Life Insurance & Yulife Wellbeing & Rewards.
Mental well-being support – Access therapy, mental health sessions, and yoga through a free premium subscription to Headspace.
EAP confidential benefit – 24/7 access to compassionate guidance & expert advice
25 days holiday + bank holidays
Training, support, and personal development

jobs.title: Graduate project manager
jobs.description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

This role sits within our Customer Support department. You’ll work on a mix of day-to-day operational needs and longer-term projects, with a focus on building the processes and systems that allow us to deliver great support efficiently and at scale.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Improve customer support operations through a range of projects—from bringing on new external providers to redesigning how support is organized and delivered.
Build and improve scalable support systems, including help centers, chatbots, automated flows, and AI-powered solutions that help users get fast, accurate answers.
Work with Product and Engineering teams to identify recurring customer issues, turn support insights into product improvements, and ensure support keeps pace with new releases.
Help shape the support experience for newly acquired products, bringing operations, tools, and processes together while identifying opportunities to improve how customers are served.
Use data and AI to understand how our support is performing, uncover opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of the changes you make.

What we look for
Reasoning ability.
Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive.
You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit.
You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English.
You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.
You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth.
We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits.
Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.
Typical annual salary offers range from £41,255 to £56,345 in London and from €39,892 to €54,346 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £85,797 in London or €82,557 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract

Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time.

Location

Milan (Italy), Warsaw (Poland), Madrid (Spain), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process

In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Closing Date

2026-09-18

Job Title: Project Manager

Location: Flexible, Hampshire, Kent & Sussex (hybrid)

Contract Type: Permanent

Hours: 37

Salary: Up to £55k based on skills and experience

About The Role

Are you ready to lead projects that help shape the future of water services?

We're looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our dynamic team, delivering a range of planned projects as part of our AMP programme.

What You Will Be Responsible For

This is an exciting opportunity to manage projects from initiation through to completion, working closely with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders to ensure safe, efficient, and sustainable delivery.

You'll play a key role in turning plans into successful outcomes, helping deliver improvements that benefit our customers, communities, and the environment.

Lead projects from initiation through to completion, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives
Develop and manage project plans, schedules, and key milestones
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams to ensure effective project delivery
Identify and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies
Foster collaboration between internal teams, contractors, and stakeholders
Monitor project performance and provide regular updates, forecasts, and reports
Ensure compliance with governance, health and safety, and business requirements
Work closely with Senior Project Managers and Programme Managers to support successful programme delivery

What You’ll Bring To The Role

You'll have experience delivering planned projects within a utility, infrastructure, construction, or engineering environment.

Organised, proactive, and capable of managing competing priorities while maintaining a strong focus on delivery.
Have experience managing projects through the full project lifecycle
Demonstrate strong planning, organisation, and stakeholder management skills
Be confident managing project risks, budgets, and schedules
Build productive relationships across a range of teams and stakeholders
Communicate effectively and provide clear project reporting and updates
Be motivated by delivering successful outcomes and continuous improvement

Southern Water is at the forefront of transforming Britain’s water industry, investing significantly to enhance resilience, sustainability, and service excellence. With £7.8bn planned investment for 2025-30, this is an unparalleled opportunity to join a business committed to delivering a generational shift in the way water services are managed.

You will be joining at a time of significant change, working alongside a highly skilled leadership team with a clear vision for the future. We offer an environment where senior professionals can make a meaningful impact, influence major strategic decisions, and drive long-term value creation.

"Our mission is to protect and enhance life through water—and we need passionate people to help us achieve it. If you’re inspired by our purpose and believe you can contribute, apply today. You don’t need to meet every criterion; what matters most is your drive to make a difference."

If this role isn’t quite what you’re looking for but are keen to be contacted about opportunities at Southern Water, you can register your details here: Introduce Yourself (myworkdaysite.com- Introduce Yourself )

Our Commitment to Diversity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Additional Information

In line with Southern Water’s security requirements, successful candidates will be required to provide evidence of their identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record check (DBS) and verification of their employment and/or education history for the past three years.

Appointment to this role is subject to the successful completion of all pre‑employment checks, including security vetting.

Please note that if a candidate does not meet the required security standards or fails to pass the vetting process, Southern Water reserves the right to withdraw the offer of employment.

Some positions may also require higher levels of security vetting, which may involve providing additional documentation.

jobs.description:
This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.

Sargent & Lundy Consulting (SLC) works on behalf of clients to support electric power projects. We evaluate and optimize technical, commercial, environmental, and financial aspects of the projects for a variety of clients.

In this role, you will provide leadership in development support, conceptual design, owner’s engineer services, and due diligence services to clients, including performing technical evaluations of electric power generation projects and facilities. You will also have the opportunity to lead project economic and cost analysis, risk assessments, and contract development. Particular experience in design or development of thermal power projects is desired.

Project Managers Must

Prepare proposals for consulting project opportunities.
Develop consulting project execution plan to meet client’s needs.
Lead project team by providing clear instruction including technical approaches.
Manage hours and work performed to budget and scope.
Review deliverables such as reports and studies.
Support multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring a high quality standard is met.
Travel occasionally to visit project locations and client offices. Travel may be domestic or international.

This position will require a great deal of face-to-face interaction with power project developers, utilities, investors, legal advisors, and financial institutions during the execution of consulting services work for the firm.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

This Position Requires a Bachelor's Degree In Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Or Civil Engineering From An ABET Engineering Accreditation Commission-approved Program With a Strong Academic Background With 15 Or More Years Of Experience In The Power Industry, Including

Owner’s engineer and/or design engineer experience for development and execution of power generation projects, including thermal generation projects
Experience managing teams of engineers
Experience performing feasibility studies for power projects
Experience with project contracts such as power purchase agreements, asset transfer agreements, and EPC contracts is a plus

Valued But Not Required Skills And Experience

Experience in technical due diligence and owner’s engineering design reviews of power projects is a plus.
General understanding of power station operations and performance reviews is a plus.
General understanding of process design at electric power generation facilities is a plus.
Economic, cost analysis, and contract development experience is a plus.

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
For the 15th consecutive year, World Wide Technology (WWT) has secured a place among the best companies to work for worldwide, ranking 10th on Fortune's Global list of best workplaces. That’s not a coincidence — it’s the result of a culture built around one belief: our people are our greatest asset. Join us, and you’ll be joining a truly international, fast-growing organization that invests in your growth as much as it does in its technology.

Who We Are

World Wide Technology is a global technology solutions provider with more than $20 billion in annual revenue and over 12,000 employees worldwide. Since 1990, we’ve grown from a technology reseller into one of the largest privately-held companies in the world, partnering with 80+ of the Fortune 100 and top technology providers like Cisco and NVIDIA. Our expertise spans AI, cybersecurity, digital transformation, cloud and data center infrastructure, networking, data analytics, and automation — helping organizations bring transformational ideas to life, safely and at scale.

Behind every solution we deliver is a robust global supply chain and logistics operation, and our warehouse teams are essential to keeping that engine running for customers around the world.

World Wide Technology EMEA has an opportunity available for a Associate
Project Manager
position.

The Associate Project Manager is responsible for supporting the coordination of all aspects of assigned projects to meet and exceed customer expectations. Understands the programmatic approach (including global) and possesses the ability to build program structure. Incorporates lessons learned into continuous process improvement actions either within supply chain or elsewhere in the business.

Inserimento urgente. Collaborazione preferibilmente in Partita IVA, con possibilità di assunzione immediata o futura.

DRIMZ sta cercando un Digital Project Manager & Account da inserire nel proprio team di Genova.
Cerchiamo una figura trasversale, capace di seguire un progetto dal rapporto con il cliente fino alla sua realizzazione.

Non cerchiamo un Project Manager che si limiti a coordinare persone, task e scadenze.
Cerchiamo qualcuno che sappia anche fare.

Una persona con competenze digitali concrete, capace di entrare operativamente nei progetti quando necessario: contribuire alla costruzione di un piano editoriale, impostare una newsletter, lavorare a una presentazione, revisionare un contenuto, organizzare una landing page o supportare il team nella preparazione di una campagna.

Non è necessario essere specialisti in tutto. È necessario avere una buona cultura digitale, capacità di imparare velocemente e sufficiente autonomia per passare dal coordinamento all’operatività.

COSA FARAI
• Gestione quotidiana del rapporto con clienti e partner
• Raccolta dei brief e trasformazione delle richieste in attività concrete
• Coordinamento di progetti di comunicazione, digital, web e advertising
• Pianificazione di attività, priorità, scadenze e risorse
• Coordinamento del lavoro di designer, developer, social media manager, AI specialist e altri professionisti
• Supervisione dello stato di avanzamento e della qualità dei progetti
• Partecipazione operativa ai progetti quando necessario
• Supporto alla costruzione di piani editoriali e calendari di comunicazione
• Ideazione, impostazione e revisione di newsletter e DEM
• Preparazione di presentazioni, proposte e materiali per clienti
• Revisione di copy, contenuti e materiali prodotti dal team
• Supporto nell’impostazione di landing page, siti e contenuti digitali
• Utilizzo di strumenti AI per velocizzare e migliorare attività operative e organizzative
• Organizzazione di meeting, call e presentazioni con i clienti
• Individuazione di nuove esigenze e opportunità sui clienti seguiti

CHI CERCHIAMO
Cerchiamo prima di tutto una persona versatile.
Qualcuno che sappia gestire un cliente e organizzare il lavoro, ma che davanti a un’attività da portare a termine non abbia come unica risposta “devo passarla al team”.
È importante avere:
• Esperienza in agenzia, studio digitale, reparto marketing o realtà comparabili
• Esperienza nella gestione di clienti o progetti
• Buona conoscenza del digital marketing e della comunicazione
• Capacità di scrivere e revisionare contenuti
• Familiarità con social media, newsletter, siti web e campagne digitali
• Capacità di costruire un piano editoriale partendo dagli obiettivi del cliente
• Buona sensibilità visiva e capacità di valutare la qualità di un contenuto
• Capacità di lavorare con CMS e strumenti digitali
• Ottime capacità organizzative e di gestione delle priorità
• Capacità di seguire contemporaneamente più progetti
• Ottime capacità comunicative, scritte e verbali
• Autonomia, precisione e problem solving

Il background può essere diverso.

Ci interessano anche profili che arrivano dal design, dalla comunicazione, dal social media management, dal content marketing o dal mondo web e che nel tempo hanno sviluppato capacità di gestione di clienti e progetti.

COSTITUISCONO UN PLUS
• Competenze grafica pubblicitaria o art direction
• Conoscenza di WordPress
• Esperienza con piattaforme di email marketing e marketing automation
• Esperienza nella gestione di social media e piani editoriali
• Conoscenza delle principali dinamiche di advertising digitale
• Utilizzo avanzato di strumenti di intelligenza artificiale
• Conoscenza di Figma e della suite Adobe
• Familiarità con strumenti di project management
• Esperienza nella preparazione di preventivi e proposte commerciali
• Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese

COSA CI INTERESSA DAVVERO
Cerchiamo una persona capace di passare con naturalezza dalla visione generale al dettaglio operativo.
La mattina potrebbe essere in call con un cliente per definire le priorità di un progetto, poco dopo confrontarsi con un designer su una campagna, nel pomeriggio sistemare personalmente una newsletter e infine organizzare le attività del team per la settimana successiva.
Non deve necessariamente essere la persona più specializzata nella stanza.
Deve però capire il lavoro degli specialisti, saperlo coordinare e avere abbastanza competenze trasversali da contribuire concretamente quando serve.

MODALITÀ DI COLLABORAZIONE
La ricerca ha carattere urgente.

Valutiamo prioritariamente professionisti disponibili a iniziare una collaborazione in Partita IVA, ma siamo interessati anche a profili disponibili per un’assunzione immediata o futura.

Cerchiamo una persona interessata a costruire un rapporto continuativo con DRIMZ e a diventare progressivamente un punto di riferimento per clienti, progetti e team.

Per la natura trasversale e operativa del ruolo, la presenza a Genova è fondamentale.
DRIMZ è una realtà nata a Genova che lavora all’intersezione tra creatività, tecnologia e intelligenza artificiale.
Sviluppiamo progetti di comunicazione, prodotti digitali, sistemi AI, automazioni e nuove soluzioni tecnologiche per aziende e organizzazioni.

Sede: Genova

OFFERTA ECONOMICA

Compenso iniziale indicativo da 1.000 € a 2.200 € al mese, definito in base all’esperienza, alle competenze, alla disponibilità e alla modalità di collaborazione.

La fascia si riferisce alla prima fase del rapporto. Con l’evoluzione delle responsabilità e del ruolo all’interno di DRIMZ, condizioni e compenso potranno essere rivalutati.

Job Description

Gestionnaire de projet – Hydroélectricité et barrages, Ontario et Atlantique

Et si vous pouviez redéfinir ce qui est possible? Avec nous, c’est possible.

Vous cherchez du sens. De la croissance. Des occasions
. Des gens qui comprennent.

Nous sommes la maison des personnes ambitieuses, passionnées et innovantes qui façonnent le monde.

Grâce à une expertise inégalée en ingénierie, en services-conseils et en sciences, nos esprits globaux s’unissent pour alimenter des solutions locales. Nous sommes des éclaireurs et des créateurs d’impact.

Nous sommes des Visionniers et Visionnières
. Nous sommes WSP
.

L’occasion

Bâtissez l’avenir avec nous.

À titre de gestionnaire de projet – Hydroélectricité et barrages
, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la réalisation de projets complexes d’infrastructures hydroélectriques en Ontario et dans les provinces de l’Atlantique. Votre travail contribuera à la fiabilité, à la modernisation et à la résilience d’infrastructures énergétiques essentielles dont dépendent des millions de personnes.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de conception en hydroélectricité et barrages ainsi qu’avec nos gestionnaires de marché afin de diriger et de gérer des projets et des occasions d’affaires pour divers clients. Ce poste est basé dans l’un de nos bureaux en Ontario ou dans les provinces de l’Atlantique.

Vous collaborerez avec des équipes techniques multidisciplinaires, des partenaires des services publics, des entrepreneurs et des parties prenantes, contribuant ainsi à la planification et à la réalisation d’investissements d’infrastructure significatifs et à fort impact qui renforcent les communautés et façonnent l’avenir énergétique des provinces.

Notre division Énergie – Canada
, au sein de l’ERI, soutient ses clients d’un océan à l’autre. Au fil des décennies, nous avons développé une vaste gamme de services, incluant la préparation d’études techniques spécialisées, la gestion de projets, la conception détaillée et les services sur site. Notre expertise est reconnue sur le marché tant pour les projets de développement que de réhabilitation. Nos spécialistes collaborent afin d’offrir à nos clients des services à la hauteur de notre vision : respecter les plus hauts standards de l’industrie et innover pour les dépasser.

Votre impact

Gérer des projets multidisciplinaires en hydroélectricité et en barrages;
Développer, maintenir et renforcer des relations clients à long terme;
Faire preuve de leadership de façon continue;
Participer à des conférences et à des formations afin de promouvoir WSP et de maintenir les relations clients;
Voyager à l’occasion pour des réunions de projet, des visites de sites, des formations et d’autres activités connexes;
Soutenir les processus de gestion de projets de WSP, de l’opportunité à la clôture (démarrage, planification, exécution, suivi et fermeture);
Suivre les coûts et les échéanciers des projets à l’aide d’outils et de techniques appropriés, incluant la gestion de la valeur acquise (EVM).

Les compétences qui vous distinguent

Baccalauréat en génie civil, structure ou géotechnique;
Expérience à titre de réviseur(se) principal(e) sur des projets en hydroélectricité et barrages;
Minimum de 12 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets et solide réseau dans le secteur de l’hydroélectricité et des barrages, idéalement en Ontario et/ou dans le Canada atlantique;
Expérience marquée en gestion de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires;
Excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite;
Capacité à planifier, organiser et prioriser le travail, et à travailler efficacement en équipe;
Initiative, proactivité, autonomie et grand souci du détail;
Capacité à respecter les échéanciers et à gérer efficacement plusieurs tâches en parallèle;
Connaissance de logiciels de planification tels que MS Project ou Primavera P6 (un atout);
Membre en règle de l’Ordre des ingénieurs de l’Ontario ou admissible à l’inscription (un atout);
MBA ou certification PMP (un atout);
Approche proactive en résolution de problèmes et solides compétences en prise de décision.

Pourquoi choisir WSP?

Nous existons pour façonner des communautés et faire progresser l’humanité. Les ingénieurs, conseillers et scientifiques les plus brillants du monde entier font de WSP leur maison.

Fièrement canadienne – nous faisons partie des 100 meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026
Une communauté mondiale d’experts – votre prochaine idée, mentor ou opportunité est toujours à portée de main
Des possibilités illimitées commencent ici. Que ce soit à travers le pays ou à l’échelle mondiale, nous vous aiderons à adapter votre rôle à vos ambitions — parce que votre croissance alimente la nôtre
Flexibilité et équilibre réel – nous reconnaissons l’importance de l’équilibre dans nos vies et vous encourageons à prioriser le vôtre.

Prêt(e) à façonner l’avenir?

Faites partie d’une équipe qui propulse le progrès des infrastructures énergétiques essentielles du Canada. Votre impact commence ici — joignez-vous à nous pour bâtir la suite.

Nous allions une connaissance approfondie des réalités locales à une perspective globale pour créer des solutions qui laissent une empreinte positive et durable.

Outform Group specializes in creating tangible consumer engagements that elevate, connect and humanize brand experiences. We unite leading experts in research, strategy, design, innovation and manufacturing, who work together to create unforgettable brand experiences.

Lean, interdisciplinary teams work in close collaboration with clients, helping them to solve their user’s biggest problems. Our user-centric, data-driven approach focuses on creating a seamless experience across different environments.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager
to own and drive complex, high‑visibility technology initiatives from concept through global deployment.

This role requires a seasoned technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, navigates complexity with ease, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to deeply understand technologies that power modern retail experiences. Curiosity, technical breadth, and strong execution discipline are essential.

DIRECT REPORTS

None

SCOPE & ACCOUNTABILITY

This role owns the full lifecycle of complex, high-visibility technology programs—from initial scoping and architecture through global deployment and long-term support. The Senior Technical Project Manager serves as the central technical authority and primary client-facing leader for large-scale retail technology initiatives, with initial focus on multi-phase LED video wall programs for a major retail brand. This position carries direct accountability for program outcomes across scope, timeline, budget, and quality, while simultaneously building and maintaining high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones. The role operates with significant autonomy and is expected to make high-impact decisions that shape both client experience and internal capability.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Oversight

Provide senior-level oversight across multiple concurrent technology programs, ensuring technical feasibility, design excellence, and flawless execution within scope, timeline, and budget.
Evaluate project opportunities, define high-level architecture, determine resource needs, and guide teams through complex decision-making.
Lead the development and integration of hardware, software, and physical display systems, ensuring seamless performance in demanding retail environments.
Build and maintain high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones.
Define technical requirements, develop comprehensive technology BOMs, and guide sourcing, procurement, and estimation strategies.

Program & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, translating their goals into actionable technical plans and delivering executive-level communication.
Oversee large-scale project roadmaps, risk mitigation strategies, and milestone tracking across multiple parallel workstreams.
Maintain and evolve technical documentation, including wiring schematics, integration maps, digital die lines, and BOMs.
Define and implement documentation standards, QA processes, and best practices for installation, support, and troubleshooting.
Lead internal and external status meetings, delivering clear updates to senior stakeholders.

Hands-On Technical Execution

Personally evaluate, test, and validate technology solutions as part of pre-sale exploration, prototyping, and client demonstrations.
Build quick-turn prototypes and technology demos that support new business development and innovation initiatives.
Act as a tier-two escalation point for complex troubleshooting, ensuring issues are resolved swiftly and root causes are understood.
Partner with technology vendors to scope, assess, and co-develop solutions tailored for retail activation.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

Operate as the central hub between engineering, design, production, sourcing, and client teams—translating technical details into clear, actionable insights.
Foster an inclusive and collaborative environment that encourages experimentation, knowledge sharing, and creative problem-solving.
Anticipate communication gaps and proactively bridge them across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to scaling technical project management capabilities across the organization.

KEY INTERFACES (NON-REPORTING)

This role collaborates consistently with the following teams and functions outside its direct reporting structure: Engineering and Software Development teams (hardware/software integration), Design and Creative teams (retail experience and display design), Production and Fabrication teams (manufacturing and physical build), Sourcing and Procurement teams (vendor and component management), Client stakeholders and executive sponsors, Technology Vendors and LED/digital signage suppliers, Global Manufacturing Partners (including production facilities in China), and Installation and Field Support teams.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Success in this role will be measured against metrics including but not limited to:

On-time and on-budget delivery rate across assigned technology programs
Client satisfaction scores and retention on managed accounts
Prototype and demo quality as measured by client approval and conversion
Speed and effectiveness of issue resolution (escalation response time)
Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation (BOMs, schematics, integration maps)
Cross-functional team feedback on communication clarity and collaboration
Adherence to QA standards and reduction in post-installation defects

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field preferred; equivalent work experience accepted. Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in a technical project management role within experiential, retail, hardware, software, or systems integration environments.

Technical Knowledge

Strong foundation in both hardware and software systems with ability to engage in deep technical discussions
Prior experience with LED systems, digital signage, and retail technology highly preferred
Familiarity with wiring schematics, integration maps, and technology BOMs
Hands-on technical aptitude (e.g., PC building, coding, home networking, video editing, or interactive technology tinkering)

Program Management Skills

Proven track record managing large, multi-stakeholder programs with competing priorities
Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation, QA processes, and installation standards
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

Communication & Leadership

Exceptional communication and leadership presence with demonstrated client-facing skills
Ability to translate complex technical information for non-technical audiences
Experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders

Other Requirements

Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time (domestic and international, including China)
Availability for weekly calls with teams in China across time zones

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES & PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

Strategic & Innovative Thinker: Approaches problems with a forward-thinking mindset, comfortable owning high-impact decisions and operating with autonomy in ambiguous situations.

Exceptional Communicator: Able to simplify technical complexity for any audience—from engineers to C-suite executives—with clarity, confidence, and precision.

Trust Builder: Earns credibility through deep preparation, technical intelligence, and consistent execution. Develops high-trust relationships with clients, vendors, and internal teams alike.

Relentless Problem Solver: Thrives under pressure with a track record of delivering results. Approaches obstacles with a solutions-oriented mindset and never leaves an issue unresolved.

Collaborative Influencer: Skilled at guiding cross-functional decisions and rallying diverse teams behind a shared goal without formal authority.

Passionate About Retail Technology: Genuinely energized by leveraging technology to create best-in-class customer experiences in physical retail environments.

Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented: Consistently meets deadlines, maintains rigorous documentation standards, and keeps complex programs on track simultaneously.

Self-Driven & Proactive: Takes initiative without being prompted, anticipates needs before they arise, and is energized by building what doesn’t yet exist.

Positive Can-Do Attitude: Willing to jump in wherever and whenever needed, bringing energy and optimism to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Essential Functions

Working conditions are in a normal office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk, sit, and stand, using hands to handle, finger, or feel objects, tools, or controls. Occasionally, the employee must crouch or kneel. The employee must occasionally exert or lift up to 20 pounds. Successful performance requires good eyesight with or without corrective lenses. Requires long periods of time working at a computer and includes phone work. Travel up to 30% of the time is required and is an essential function of this position.

Japan Store Tech (JST) is a global innovation hub rooted in deep knowledge of customers and businesses in Japan. You must be able to engage engineers and senior technical leaders in architecture discussions, understand dependencies and failure modes across complex systems, and identify risks created by technical or organizational complexity. You will influence teams without direct authority, resolve disagreements, and establish mechanisms that make delivery faster and more predictable.

This is an opportunity to help Amazon Japan create a new customer proposition, solve complex technical and business problems, and build capabilities with the potential to benefit customers beyond Japan.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities

Translate ambiguous customer and business needs into clear program objectives, technical requirements, success metrics, roadmaps, and milestones.
Partner with engineers, product managers, and senior technical leaders to drive decisions about system architecture, interfaces, data flows, integrations, and implementation strategy.
Build and maintain an integrated program plan covering the critical path, cross-team dependencies, decisions, resources, risks, and release readiness.
Identify risks related to technical complexity, external dependencies, resource constraints, quality, security, privacy, compliance, and operations; drive mitigations before they become delivery blockers.
Coordinate technical integrations with internal systems and external partners, including requirements, interface agreements, testing, launch sequencing, and operational ownership.
Define program-health, customer-impact, quality, and operational metrics; use data to identify problems and drive continuous improvement.
Ensure that security, privacy, legal, and operational requirements are incorporated into designs, delivery plans, and launch decisions.
Communicate complex technical and business topics clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to senior leaders.

You will work with engineering, product, business, operations, and specialist teams to turn an ambiguous customer need into an executable technical program. Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

jobs.description:
Description

The Program Manager, Secure Network Design support the End-to-End Secure Network (E2ESN) organization within World Wide Operations Security WWOS, driving programs that create Earth's most reliably secure supply chain through prevention, intervention, and investigation. This role combines Amazon's core program management competencies with domain-specific expertise to architect, plan, and secure Amazon's global transportation network across supply chain miles – Global Mile, First Mile and Middle Mile OTR. Team apply the "Shift-Left" principle to engineer resilience into the network design architecture itself, building a capability that prevents incidents by design rather than chasing them after the fact.

Key job responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

Owns the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across organizations or geographies
Define program scope, goals, success criteria, and inputs/outputs metrics in collaboration with stakeholders
Develop and maintain program roadmaps, glidepaths, and work-back schedules aligned to OP planning cycles
Drive mechanisms (WBRs, MBRs, portfolio reviews) to track progress vs. plan and surface risks early
Accountable for overall program strategy and tactically driving teams inside and outside the organization to deliver

Secure Network Design

Architect a Secure-by-Design Transportation Network, embed security principles into network design decisions where security becomes a primary design variable alongside cost, speed, and service level.
Defines secured network path strategies that ensure that theft and loss are structurally designed out through preventive architecture before they materialize
Enable actionable intelligence that drives systematic improvements across the network
Measure adoption rates and alignment metrics for deployed solutions
Leverage AI-driven decision support and ensure investments are focused on the most at-risk vulnerabilities for maximum impact

Stakeholder Management & Influence

Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Tech, Legal, and WWOS teams - Field Loss Prevention, Investigation teams.
Facilitate alignment across AMER and INTL regional teams to ensure consistent solution deployment and best practices adoption
Represent program status and strategic direction in leadership reviews
Serve as the bridge between E2ESN Solutions teams and partner teams
Build and maintain relationships with partner organizations

Delivery & Operational Excellence

Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and escalate appropriately through WWOS governance
Manage dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams
Makes appropriate trade-offs to optimize timelines and deliverables in consultation with stakeholders
Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and mechanism design
Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for program operations

Data & Analytics Stewardship

Own program-level data quality, ensuring accurate $ loss / entitlement attribution by supply chain segment
Partner with Data Services teams for dashboard development and automated network coverage tracking
Parter with Finance team to drive theft/loss estimates using statistical models
Support AI/ML integration into security solutions to reduce manual investigative burden

Basic Qualifications

Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
Bachelor's degree or equivalent
Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
Ability to collaborate and lead in a flexible, detail-oriented, fast-paced team environment
Demonstrated ability to independently use AI tools in daily work, integrating them into program workflows to drive better outcomes, and guiding others on effective adoption

Preferred Qualifications

Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
Six-Sigma or equivalent certification
Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
ISO 28000 (Supply Chain Security Management System) or TAPA (Transported Asset Protection Association) certification
Experience with supply chain security frameworks (ASIS, AIBM-CSCRM)

In your role as Business Operations Analyst (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
CAI Overview:

Are You Ready?

CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown to over 700 people worldwide. We provide program and project management, commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, and other consulting services associated with operational readiness and operational excellence to FDA-regulated and other mission-critical industries.

We put our clients’ interests first, we do not stop until it is right, and we will do whatever it takes to get there.

At CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles:

We act with integrity

We Serve Each Other

We serve society

We work for our future

We believe that with employee ownership, one person’s success is everyone’s success. We embrace a Team Before Self
mindset, demonstrate Respect for Others
, and maintain a Can-Do Attitude
—our three core values.

Position Overview:

The Operational Readiness Project Manager (ORPM) serves as a strategic leader bridging the gap between mechanical completion and sustained operational performance. The ORPM designs and leads holistic Operational Readiness programs using CAI’s six-pillar Readiness Framework. This role ensures project teams achieve right-first-time metrics, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and deliver world-class performance from day one.

Key Responsibilities:

Project & Program Leadership
Lead project teams to achieve Operational Readiness (OR) objectives.
Manage readiness-to-operations lifecycle for 1–3 client engagements simultaneously.
Drive on-time, on-scope delivery of readiness programs.
Pillar Integration & Execution
Serve as the primary consultant for OR campaigns integrating with Quality, Process, and Workforce streams.
Apply OE principles to pre-Day One activities (e.g., visual management, accountability, problem-solving).
Client Advisory
Act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders (VPs, Site Heads, etc.).
Guide decision-making with a risk-based, speed-to-value mindset.
People Development
Lead and coach cross-functional teams including CQV, Quality, and external contractors.
Cultivate a culture of feedback and growth.
Thought Leadership
Contribute to CAI's brand via white papers, conference presentations, and client tools.

Skills & Characteristics Required:

Consulting & Facilitation
Align project stakeholders with clear vision and measurable goals.
Expert-level guidance for site and department leadership.
Project Execution
Manage scheduling, resource loading, controls, and closeout.
Execute comprehensive project planning and delivery.
Continuous Improvement
Drive site-wide transformation using Lean, Six Sigma, or TPM methodologies.

Qualifications and Experience:

BS or MS in a relevant science or engineering field (or equivalent).
3+ years as a program/project manager on life science projects ($1MM+), or
8+ years in GMP-regulated operations with 5+ years leading readiness/start-up/OE transformations.

(Black Belt or equivalent preferred.)

Proven multi-site or multi-client portfolio experience.
Deep understanding of quality systems, tech transfer, equipment qualification, and analytics.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficient in project management software tools.

Other Requirements:

Excellent written and verbal English communication.
Able to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.
Domestic and international travel may be required.
Willing to work overtime when necessary.
PMI PMP or PgMP certification a plus.

Critical Competencies

Influence Strategy

Evaluates and pursues initiatives, opportunities, and priorities based on fit with organization strategies.
Identifies innovative solutions to challenges that have strategic impact, balancing both short- and long-term concerns.
Identifies issues related to emerging customer and market needs.

Satisfy the Customer

Identifies and anticipates customer requirements, expectations, and needs.
Develops solutions that meet or exceed customer expectations and shares feedback with relevant groups.
Consistently follows up with customers to resolve issues and maintain customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Continually searches for ways to improve customer service, including removal of barriers and providing solutions.

Plan for Success

Translates business/function strategies into aligned plans and objectives and integrates across business groups.
Obtains and allocates resources needed to accomplish goals.
Anticipates risk and builds effective contingency plans.

Pursue Execution

Prioritizes and balances time, actions, resources, and initiatives to ensure achievement of critical goals.
Holds self and others accountable for achieving outcomes.
Anticipates obstacles and takes appropriate actions to accelerate work or improve quality.

Tailor Communication

Communicates information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
Tailors communication style and content to audience effectively.
Writes technical concepts clearly and thoroughly for all audience types.

Build Partnerships

Cultivates a network of people across a variety of disciplines and functions within the organization.
Builds collaboration by identifying and conveying common interests and priorities, removing barriers, and breaking down silos.
Appropriately involves others in decisions and plans that affect them.
Maintains positive relationships regardless of challenges, organizational level, personality, or background differences.

Influence Others

Develops and articulates compelling rationale for positions.
Builds a broad base of support among key decision makers and influencers.
Positions and explains ideas and proposals in ways that get support from others.
Encourages others to find new solutions that improve outcomes and deliver value.

Develop Self And Others

Continuously develops interpersonal skills to build effective internal and external relationships.
Models company values and always acts with integrity.
Looks for opportunities to develop breakthrough ideas and initiatives.

We pledge that CAI will be operated in a way that is fair and equitable to all – our employees, our customers, and the broader society.

Proven experience of project management at practitioner level across multiple projects at the same time with complex reporting structures.
Proven experience in managing both project delivery and commercial performance, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, and on budget while optimising financial outcomes and driving value for the business.
Experience leading or working as part of a high performing team, with the ability to influence and motivate others with different levels of experience and skills.
Experience working either as a client, consultant or contractor, in public and/or private sector environments delivering complex projects/programmes.

Robust project management skills with a track record for the successful project delivery, ideally within a transport, public sector, or high-risk environment. The capability in managing proposals and bids, including comprehensive bid planning, efficient resource coordination, and high-quality proposal writing.
Proven ability to lead and manage complex matrix environments, effectively coordinating and collaborating with multiple subject matter experts and stakeholders across various functions to ensure alignment.
Excellent relationship management skills with proven experience in building rapport and trust with colleagues, clients and key stakeholders.
Excellent communication (both verbal and written) and interpersonal skills; able to influence, engender commitment to deliver on a purpose and engage with people.

A proven ability to work collaboratively within real and virtual environments, sharing information and engaging the right people to make decisions in an effective and timely manner.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

With us, you can. Apply today.

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Your development

#WeAreWSP

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The TikTok Privacy & Responsibility Product division's goal is to meet all of our privacy, responsibility, and compliance requirements, while providing the best user experience to responsibly consume, create, and enjoy content on TikTok. We focus on building infrastructure and user-facing tools that uphold data transparency, empower user control, and earn trust at scale. As part of this team, you'll help shape the future of privacy on one of the world's most influential platforms, balancing regulatory demands with innovation and usability.

Platform Responsibility team builds the systems that keep our community safe.

You are responsible for developing product safety narratives (internal and external), in close step with XFNs, to demonstrate our responsibility. Your primary role is not that of an external spokesperson or a policy writer.

You will deeply understand product strategies and concepts, write the canonical narratives, coach the wider product org, and act as the trusted single point of contact.

What You Will Own
- Build the Communication Tiering Mechanism
- Tier 1 — Proactive Trust Baseline. Run a recurring cadence of product methodology and roadmap updates to PR / GR / Legal, building mutual fluency before crises hit.
- Tier 2 — Major Launch Alignment. For every significant safety product launch, drive cross-functional pre-launch alignment: define risks, set communication prerequisites (Help Center articles, FAQs), ensure we ship with our story already told.
- Tier 3 — Thematic Deep-Dives. Identify recurring high-stakes topics (e.g., minor safety, predatory behavior governance, machine-moderation logic) and produce canonical internal references.

- Shape Narrative, Not Just Summarize Facts
- Shift the team from reactive fact-collecting to proactive proposition-setting. Hold a clear point of view on what story we want to tell about safety philosophy, then mine facts to support it.
- Translate complex product mechanics into human-centric, press, and policy audiences.
- Maintain our safety design philosophy as a living document; ensure it is consistently reflected in product decisions and external statements.

- Be the Single Point of Contact in High-Stakes Moments
- Serve as the strategic product-side POC for PR / GR / Legal on required communications.
- Lead product-side contribution to inquiries and crisis response, ensuring responses are strategically aligned, technically accurate, and free of over-promises.
- Enable the Wider Product Org
- Coach PMs on narrative construction and stakeholder communication. Build a self-sustaining culture where product decisions ship with their story already articulated.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)
- Experience: proven experience in Trust & Safety, Policy Communications, Public Affairs, or Product Marketing within a social media platform. Proven track record of driving cross-functional initiatives (across Product, Comms, GR, Legal) without direct authority.
- Storytelling & Acumen: Demonstrated ability to translate highly technical product logic into persuasive, human-centric narratives. High sensitivity to industry trends, media appetite, and regulatory concerns — knowing instinctively what stories resonate with the public and what risks trigger scrutiny. (Writing samples required).
- Domain Expertise: Depth in at least one safety & compliance vertical (e.g., Minor Safety, Content Integrity, AI Safety) and working fluency with at least one major global safety regulatory regime (e.g., UK OSA / OFCOM, EU DSA, US state-level regimes).
- Language: Fluency in written and spoken Chinese is needed to manage stakeholders in the Chinese market.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Prior experience operating directly inside a Trust & Safety product org, or serving as a regulator-facing communicator at a large platform company.
- Hands-on experience drafting formal, regulator-facing or media-facing materials.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. This role involves utilizing advanced data analysis tools and techniques to evaluate portfolio health, monitor credit quality, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. Ensuring transactions in the PPI Escrow and Nodal accounts are compliant with regulatory guidelines
Managing end-to-end reconciliation to identify discrepancies, establish root causes, and drive resolution through cross-functional stakeholder coordination

Lead internal and external and regulatory audits of these accounts
Advise business teams in launch of new products and capabilities w.r.t potential impact on these accounts
Closely work with accounting and finance to ensure accurate representation in entity accounts
Drive continuous improvement and automation

3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
Experience in MS Access and SQL
Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams

About The Company

University Health is a leading healthcare organization committed to providing exceptional patient care, innovative medical services, and advancing health research. With a strong emphasis on community health and wellness, University Health integrates cutting-edge technology, dedicated healthcare professionals, and comprehensive programs to serve diverse populations. Our mission is to improve health outcomes through quality care, education, and research, making a positive impact on the communities we serve.

About The Role

The Risk Adjustment Data Analyst at University Health plays a vital role in supporting the organization’s Risk Adjustment program. This position involves detailed data analysis, reporting, and medical record retrieval to ensure accurate risk adjustment and compliance with regulatory standards. The analyst collaborates with internal departments, provider networks, and external vendors to gather and analyze data, identify trends, and monitor key performance indicators related to Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) capture. The role is essential in enhancing risk adjustment outcomes, supporting medical record initiatives, and ensuring adherence to CMS requirements. The ideal candidate will utilize health informatics tools to support data validation, provider performance analysis, and regulatory reporting, contributing to the organization’s strategic goals of quality improvement and financial sustainability.

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, health information management, or a related field is preferred. Candidates should possess a minimum of two (2) years of experience in healthcare data analysis, medical record retrieval, or related areas. Prior experience with Risk Adjustment, managed care, health plan operations, or healthcare analytics is highly desirable. Familiarity with healthcare data systems, electronic health records (EHRs), and medical record retrieval processes is advantageous. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other analytics tools is required. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong analytical skills, organizational abilities, and excellent communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with providers, vendors, and cross-functional teams is essential for success in this role.

Responsibilities

The Risk Adjustment Data Analyst will be responsible for supporting the organization’s risk adjustment initiatives through various activities, including:

Analyzing healthcare data to identify trends and opportunities for improving risk adjustment outcomes.
Supporting Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) capture efforts by reviewing and validating data accuracy.
Coordinating with provider networks and external vendors to facilitate timely and accurate medical record retrieval.
Generating detailed reports and dashboards to monitor key performance indicators related to risk adjustment.
Assisting with medical record retrieval initiatives to ensure compliance with CMS and organizational standards.
Conducting provider performance analysis to identify areas for improvement and training opportunities.
Ensuring regulatory compliance through accurate and timely reporting to CMS and other governing bodies.
Collaborating with cross-departmental teams to support data validation and quality assurance processes.
Utilizing health informatics tools such as Microsoft Power BI or similar platforms for data visualization and reporting.

University Health offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees. Benefits include competitive salary packages, health insurance coverage, dental and vision plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. We also provide a supportive work environment that encourages work-life balance, continuous learning, and career advancement. Our commitment to employee wellness and engagement ensures that team members are motivated and equipped to deliver exceptional healthcare services.

Equal Opportunity

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We believe diversity enriches our organization and enhances our ability to serve our community effectively. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and organizational needs.
