jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

The Business Operations Manager is a generalist, cross-functional leader who bridges the business, data, and engineering/AI teams and is responsible for enabling high-quality, data-driven decision-making, operational alignment, and communication across the organization. This role establishes and facilitates the business processes, operating rhythms, and governance that enable Engineering, Programs, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and other functional teams to make informed decisions, manage risk, and execute against company priorities, with a specific focus on driving efficient data flows and partnering with software/AI teams to operationalize our most critical, data-driven business decisions such as budgeting and capital investment (capex).

This role owns making the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) process more efficient and effective, facilitating aspects of it as a central cross-functional forum to align demand, supply, capacity, inventory, and financial objectives, including the inputs that feed downstream decisions like budgeting and capital planning. Beyond SIOP, this person will help identify which other operational processes the business strategically needs and then design, stand up, and lead them, bringing the same cross-functional rigor and data discipline applied to SIOP.

Success in this role requires navigating ambiguity, translating complex data into actionable insights, aligning stakeholders with competing priorities, and continually improving the systems, analytics, AI/automation tooling, and governance that support operational excellence in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The Role

Own aspects of and continually improve the company's monthly SIOP process, ensuring timely inputs, scenario analysis, and clear decisions at each step, while concurrently owning other strategic, cross-functional processes that affect operational decision-making and require the same rigor.
Facilitate structured business reviews, SIOP and beyond, that align Sales, Programs, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and other functional teams around priorities, risks, dependencies, and execution plans.
Translate ambiguous business questions (e.g., "should we approve this capex request?") into the data, reporting structure, and process needed to answer them repeatably, not just producing a one-off analysis.
Develop and maintain trusted reporting dashboards, KPIs, and data governance processes that provide leadership with accurate, actionable insights.
Partner closely with data science, digital, and AI/automation teams to improve planning systems, reporting capabilities, automation, and analytics that support scalable business operations, including hands-on evaluation and direction of new AI-enabled tools as they become available, not just coordinating with the teams that build them.
Identify cross-functional risks, constraints, and opportunities, driving mitigation plans and ensuring decisions are documented, communicated, and executed.
Partner with Finance and functional leaders to ensure operational plans support strategic and financial objectives.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating existing processes, identifying inefficiencies and opportunities, partnering with functional leaders to design improved ways of working, and driving measurable improvements to operational performance.
Lead implementation of process improvements through excellent project management, stakeholder coordination and buy-in, defining business requirements, supporting software system development, driving change management, and ensuring successful adoption of new processes and tools.

Basic Qualifications

Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls.
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Engineering, Business, Finance, or related field.
5 – 8+ years of progressive experience in business operations, S&OP/SIOP, program management, supply chain, production planning, engineering operations, or other cross-functional operational leadership roles within advanced manufacturing, electronics, aerospace, medical devices, or related technology-intensive sectors.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with a proven ability to influence and drive decisions cross-functionally and at all levels of an organization (executive leadership to execution teams).
Experience leading impactful cross-functional projects involving data and business processes.
Hands-on data query and analysis ability (e.g., SQL, Python, or R).
Able to translate an ambiguous business question into the data and reporting structure needed to answer it repeatably.
Comfortable partnering with software engineering and AI/ML teams - can scope requirements, evaluate tooling, and speak credibly about feasibility and tradeoffs without being a hands-on engineer.
Has worked in a scaling or fast-changing environment where processes had to be built from the ground up, not just inherited and maintained; comfortable with ambiguity and a lack of existing playbooks.
Track record designing and standing up new operational processes from scratch, not just optimizing existing ones.
Experience supporting recurring, high-stakes business decision cycles such as budgeting, forecasting, or capital investment (capex) approval workflows.
Preferred: platform proficiency in ERP/MRP and advanced planning or analytics tools (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Kinaxis, o9, Power BI, or similar).
Preferred: solid understanding of key supply chain concepts: forecasting, capacity planning, inventory optimization, lead-time management, and product lifecycle management.
Preferred: experience operating in a hardware technology environment, where physical production constraints (supply chain, capacity, lead times) intersect with software/data-driven decision-making.

Behavioral Competencies

Generalist mindset: equally comfortable in a finance/budgeting conversation, a process-mapping workshop, or a requirements discussion with engineers.
Growth mindset with a track record of building or maturing processes, not just operating in steady-state environments.
Comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous environments with imperfect data and time-constrained decisions.
Systems thinker who sees end-to-end value streams and can simplify complex data and business planning processes into high level visuals and discussions for decision-making.
Data-driven and highly analytical, comfortable challenging assumptions and using facts to resolve conflicts.
Strong collaborator who breaks down functional silos and creates shared ownership of the plan.
Bias for action, with a focus on execution, follow-through, and measurable results.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating with urgency and ambiguity while still driving structure and accountability.
Strong influencer and facilitator who can navigate conflicting priorities, challenge assumptions, and align senior leaders and technical teams around difficult tradeoff decisions.

What Success Looks Like

This is a manager-level individual-contributor role. Success is measured by how much faster and more reliably the business can move from a data-driven question - budgeting, capex, or otherwise - to an operational decision, and by the quality and durability of the processes and data flows put in place to make that repeatable

Work Environment

This role is based onsite in our Torrance, CA office.

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels S06 - S07 as evaluated through our interview process.

SIOP Manager (Lead) / S06: $133,580 - $183,680
SIOP Manager (Principal) / S07: $154,300 - $212,160

Pay Range: $133,580 USD - $212,160 USD

What We Offer:

Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

Die Gerresheimer AG notiert im SDAX an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse (ISIN: DE000A0LD6E6). www.gerresheimer.com

Als Teil der Business Unit Syringes Systems ist die Gerresheimer Bünde GmbH eine der modernsten Produktionsstätten der Welt für vorfüllbare Spritzensysteme und Karpulen. Mit rund 800 Beschäftigten gilt unser Werk in Bünde im Kreis Herford als Kompetenzzentrum der Gruppe für Spritzen, die zur Langzeitlagerung von Arzneimitteln, wie beispielsweise Impfstoffen, verwendet werden.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - FinOps, FinOps PMO
jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to continually pioneer and globalise new businesses and customer offerings. As a result, Amazon continues to grow and evolve across many different business lines. In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure-to-pay, order- to-cash and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon's businesses, from Retail, Digital and Advertising through to AWS and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance. As part of this growth we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Senior Program Manager for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) in the APAC region.

This is no ordinary Program Management role. You will own the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs that touch every aspect of our diverse, fast-paced global operations — from defining program strategy and vision through to sustained delivery and continuous improvement. As a Senior Program Manager, you will lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale business transformations, working backwards from the core problem to challenge assumptions, develop clear program tenets, and make smart trade-offs between competing priorities.

You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire delivery lifecycle, not as a peripheral tool, but as an integral part of how you plan, coordinate, track, communicate, and deliver. From generating and stress-testing program plans, to automating status aggregation across workstreams, to producing launch readiness assessments and synthesising post-launch operational data into actionable improvements, you will set the standard for AI-augmented program delivery.

You will bring high judgment to distinguish between one-way and two-way door decisions, driving rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring rigour for irreversible choices. You will take calculated risks in pursuit of breakthrough results, understanding that significant progress on a bold objective often creates more value than perfectly delivering incremental improvements. Are you ready to redefine what's possible in Program Management? Apply now and join the Amazon team driving the future of global technology and innovation.

Who Are We Looking For?

The successful candidate will bring a demonstrated ability to manage the lifecycle of complex, cross-functional programs with considerable business impact. You will have a proven track record of delivering large-scale, highly complex business program implementations in fast-paced, deadline-driven and virtual environments, ideally involving systems development and integration.

You Will Demonstrate

Active, demonstrable use of AI across the program delivery lifecycle: from planning and dependency mapping through to launch coordination, status synthesis, risk identification, and post-launch analysis. We do not want someone who knows about AI; we want someone who delivers programs differently because of it.
The ability to work backwards from the problem: challenging assumptions about how things have been done, questioning whether existing approaches are still the right ones, and designing solutions from the core problem rather than defaulting to precedent.
High-judgment decision-making: distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, applying appropriate rigour to each, and driving decisions confidently when data is incomplete.
A metrics-driven approach that goes beyond tracking numbers to designing measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics (delivery completion) from outcome metrics (business impact, stakeholder satisfaction), while knowing when to trust judgment over data.
The ability to distil complex scenarios into clear, compelling narratives and communicate persuasively at all levels — from technical engineering teams to VPs.
A track record of force multiplication: creating mechanisms, frameworks, and reusable approaches that deliver value beyond a single program.
Superior influencing and interpersonal skills to resolve conflicts, build consensus across organizations with different priorities, and drive cross-functional decision making without authority.

Key job responsibilities

Your Responsibilities Will Span Seven Core Dimensions

Stakeholder & Customer Understanding: Engage systematically with stakeholders across FinOps and partner organisations to understand business problems, constraints, and scaling factors. Gather requirements from diverse personas, distinguish representative signal from isolated requests, and drive mindful discussions that lead to crisp decisions and aligned outcomes.
Systems & Technical Awareness: Understand the systems landscape deeply — automation limitations, integration dependencies, and scaling factors. Leverage AI across the full program lifecycle: generating and stress-testing program plans, mapping dependency chains, automating status aggregation, accelerating testing coordination, producing launch readiness assessments, and synthesising post-launch data into actionable recommendations.
Strategic Thinking & Decision-Making: Work backwards from the problem — questioning proposals and testing

assumptions rather than perpetuating approaches because "that is how it has always been done." Distinguish between one-way and two-way door decisions, develop clear program tenets that guide prioritisation, and make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and deliverables with measurable success criteria.

Solution Design & Process Architecture: Design scalable program mechanisms that create predictable process paths and ensure long-term success. Streamline or eliminate excess process, steer teams away from classic failure modes, and continually strengthen FinOps PMO effectiveness by delivering innovative, think-big improvement opportunities.
Metrics & Judgment: Design measurement frameworks that distinguish output metrics from outcome metrics. Identify the highest-leverage input metrics, use AI to synthesise cross-team status inputs and identify leading indicators of delivery risk, and drive decisions confidently when data is incomplete — using judgment calibrated by experience.
Execution & Results Delivery: Lead cross-functional teams to deliver highly complex, large-scale programs from initiation through to delivery, on time and with quality. Take calculated risks where bold programmatic moves could deliver disproportionate impact, use AI to amplify personal capacity across the delivery lifecycle, and learn systematically from outcomes.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Effectively communicate with and influence senior, VP-level stakeholders across multiple parts of the organisation. Write effective narratives, influence without authority across organisations with different

priorities, and actively mentor and develop others.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of program or project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
Demonstrated, active use of AI tools across the program delivery lifecycle - not just awareness, but proven application in planning, tracking, communication, risk identification, or launch coordination

Preferred Qualifications

6+ years of driving process improvements experience
Experience designing and embedding AI-augmented workflows into program delivery (e.g., automated status synthesis,
AI-generated launch readiness assessments, predictive risk models)
Bachelor's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
Experience managing programs in finance operations, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, or payroll domains
Track record of creating reusable mechanisms and frameworks adopted beyond a single program

jobs.title: Brain Injury and Health Project Manager - TBICOE
jobs.description:
Job Description

Join the HJF Team!

HJF is seeking a Brain Injury and Health Project Manager
to drive successful completion of key deliverables and stated objectives for a single project or multiple non-integrated projects by coordinating and monitoring the status of work performed by technical staff. Provides project management and administrative support to the TBI Advisory Committee including the Chair of the Committee, the TBICoE Branch Chief, and its core members

This position will be in support of the Traumatic Brain Injury Center of Excellence (TBICoE)
in Silver Spring, MD. TBICoE is a branch of the Research Support Division in the Research and Engineering Directorate (R&E) of the Defense Health Agency (DHA). DHA is a Federal Program within the Department of Defense (DoD). TBICoE, known previously as the Defense and Veterans Brain Injury Center (DVBIC), has been congressionally mandated since 1992 and is currently a matrixed research, dissemination, and knowledge translation program, supporting warfighter brain health and readiness by advancing the traumatic brain injury state of the science and clinical standards.

TBICoE’s mission to support the warfighter is executed through subject matter experts embedded across DHA facilities with expertise in TBI clinical research investigations, surveillance, clinical tool development and training, cognitive monitoring and assessment, and dissemination of TBI tools, products, and education/training materials to DoD medical personnel, service members, including Guard, Reserve, and operational medics/corpsmen, veterans with TBI, and families/caregivers of the warfighter.

The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine (HJF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing military medicine. We serve military, medical, academic and government clients by administering, managing and supporting preeminent scientific programs that benefit members of the armed forces and civilians alike. Since its founding in 1983, HJF has served as a vital link between the military medical community and its federal and private partners. HJF's support and administrative capabilities allow military medical researchers and clinicians to maintain their scientific focus and accomplish their research goals.

Responsibilities

Demonstrates experience and ability to oversee and orchestrate and perform day-to-day management of assigned delivery order projects that involve teams of consultants and functional experts and analysts.
Ensures tasks are completed in manner that is compliant with relevant Government policies, procedures and standards.
Organizes, directs, and coordinates the planning and production of all activities associated with assigned delivery order projects.
Demonstrates attention to detail and ability to accurately capture fast-paced, dynamic communications among SMEs, analysts, and technical experts
Excellent oral and written communicator with strong interpersonal skills
Functions as primary liaison between member of the TAC and TBICoE HQ.
Responsible for scheduling meetings and any associated activities to include maintenance of calendar invitations, drafting and coordination of meeting minutes.
Project Management Planning for brain injury, warfighter brain health, and related projects such as cognitive monitoring efforts:
Acts as a subject matter expert in the planning and execution of a variety of projects related to WBHI, TAC, TBI/brain health space, and cognitive monitoring.
Is responsible, in collaboration with the TBICoE lead, for planning and overseeing of projects from initiation to close (i.e. cradle to the grave) to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and in line with PRS required quality. Develops plans giving significant considerations and monitoring of resources allocated to the project.
Develops recommendations to TBICoE government commensurate with listed responsibilities to improve the management of TBICoE projects and programs. In line with training and experience, may make recommendations on project improvements that can reduce cost or increase effectiveness and efficiencies within the project.
Monitors project progress and is independently able to keep stakeholders across several layers of leadership and subject matter expertise informed of the project progress, challenges, timelines, etc.
In collaboration with the TBICoE government, will create an accurate timeline of steps required toward project completion to ensure tasks are finished on time, adhering to PRS required quality, and within the plan confines. Will remain aware of the status and progress of the various projects they oversee.
Acts as integrator of multi-faceted viewpoints, needs, and information, to include but not limited to setting and managing staff and stakeholder expectations, developing a detailed project plan, defining the scope of the project and making recommendations on the assignment of team members to specific tasks.
May be involved in a wide variety of projects, including but not limited to projects involving clinical recommendations and tools, dissemination and implementation projects, research projects, research dissemination/translation efforts, and communication projects.
Tracks and analyzes project performance, including short and long- term goals. Measures performance by utilizing appropriate project management tools, techniques, and metrics.
Anticipates delays or roadblocks that may impact the project and communicates impact with stakeholders. Actively problem solves through issues to keep the project on track and within the plan confines.
Monitors resource allocation assigned to a project in order to keep the TBICoE lead aware of any risk or over burn of resources. Is responsible for assisting with coordination of internal resources and when required with third party vendors for the successful execution of the project(s).
Evaluate plan efficiency and effectiveness to accurately identify successes, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats (SWOT) and lessons learned.
Incorporates plan to track individual project lessons learned and emerging trends/themes across the organization to prevent similar issues in future projects and organizational approaches.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Master’s degree in health-related field (e.g., health science, public health) preferred.
Experience within similar work setting (e.g., dynamic program/policy setting, military healthcare) may be accepted in lieu of educational minimums.
Minimum 4-6 years in related experience preferred with several years’ experience as a certified PMP.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Knowledge of the duties, priorities, commitments, policies and program goals of the organization is required.
Ability to use sound judgment in problem solving and excellent interpersonal and communications skills required.
Ability to coordinate complex issues at any given time required.
Ability to anticipate needs, take initiative and strong attention to details.
Knowledge of and flexibility to work with a wide variety of staff, including military and civilian clinicians, researchers, policy makers, leadership, and administrators.
Must have a proven ability to creatively solve problems as well as excellent analytical skills. Must adhere to legal, professional and ethical codes with respect to confidentiality and privacy.
Prior experience within the DoD system strongly preferred.
National level Project Management Professional certification required.
May require US Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a T3/Secret Clearance.

Physical Capabilities

Lifting: Requires lifting materials up to 25 lbs.
Ability to stand or sit at a computer for prolonged periods.

Work Environment

This position will take place primarily in an office setting.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this position is $67,500-$89,300. Actual salary will be determined based on experience, education, etc.

Benefits

HJF offers a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on your health and well-being, from medical, dental, and vision coverage to health savings and retirement plans, and more.

Employment with HJF is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, which may include, but is not limited to, contacting your professional references, verification of previous employment, education and credentials, a criminal background check, and a department of motor vehicle (DMV) check if applicable. Any qualifications to be considered as equivalents, in lieu of stated minimums, require the prior approval of the Chief Human Resources Officer.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals With Disabilities

The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c)

jobs.description:
Company Description

Who We Are

KIPP SoCal Public Schools is a network of 20 high-performing, college-preparatory public charter schools. We educate more than 9,800 students in grades pre-K through eighth in the greater Los Angeles area and San Diego. Additionally, we support approximately 5,100 alumni on their journey to and through high school and college.

What We Believe

KIPP SoCal believes that the purpose of education is for liberation. This means that we see, develop, and inspire the limitless potential in each and all of our KIPPsters.

What We Do

At KIPP SoCal we build trusting relationships that are strengthened by high expectations and collaboration alongside laughter and joy. We set ambitious goals and hold each other accountable for students achieving their greatest potential. We work together with each other and in partnership with families and communities in the active pursuit of a more equitable world. We do the right thing, even when it's not always comfortable standing up and speaking out against anti-blackness, racism, oppression, and injustice. We persevere through obstacles and treat failure as an opportunity to learn and grow.

Job Description

The Opportunity

The Behavior Services Program Manager oversees the Behavior Team which consists of 7 Behavior Specialists.

Leadership, Advocacy, Expertise

Acts as behavioral expert and “face” of the Student Services team, providing consultation and guidance with regards to special education services, assessment, and IEP implementation as well as best practices in behavioral intervention and prevention
Stays up-to-date with district, state, federal laws and policies as they relate to special education, behavior, discipline, and MTSS
Makes evidence-based and culturally responsive recommendations for the inclusion of behavioral interventions and supports within schools
Develops and delivers high quality trainings and presentations, both in person and virtually, to various audiences, including school leaders, student services team members, interns, teachers, families, and more

Management & Hiring

Acts as Hiring Manager for Behavior Specialists updating job descriptions (when needed), designing interviews and tasks, etc.
Directly manages Behavior Specialists and the Behavior Team
Supervise the implementation of behavioral supports and assessments
Collaboratively sets performance goals, metrics, and deliverables to drive the KIPP SoCal mission and Student Services vision
Participates and leads Peer Review meetings with the Behavior Team
Evaluate the performance of all assigned direct reports through observations, feedback and coaching
Creates & seeks development opportunities for the Behavior Team
Maintains and reviews documentation
May be asked to complete functional behavior assessments, when needed

Student Safety & Crises

Like all KIPP SoCal staff, the Behavior Services Manager is a mandated reporter
Consult with School Leadership Teams on behavioral emergencies
Supports behavioral emergencies and is “on-call” when Behavioral Specialists are absent or unavailable
Experience working with child protective services, providing consultation to school and teams with regards to mandated reporting

Facilitates NCI trainings for KIPP

Special Education

Is a member of the Special Education Leadership Team
Review and ensure IEP timeline compliance
Oversees the assignment of FBA cases
Serve as member of an Individualized Education Program (IEP) team and attend meetings, as needed
Reviews and leads Peer Review process for FBAs and the Behavior Team
Provides consultation and support for high-profile IEPs, attending where appropriate
Provides training for Behavior Team around FBA reports and IEP developing (PLOPs, goals, BIPs, etc.)
Assists IEP team in making recommendations based on all relevant data

Behavioral Supports & Interventions

Sets the vision for the Behavior Intervention Team including, but not limited to: Providing training in best practices for behavior intervention; Assigning cases and managing schedules; Reviewing and providing feedback for behavior summaries and behavior plans
Part of internal Nonviolent Crisis Intervention trainer team, collaboratively leading training for school-based staff for certification
Supports schools with understanding and implementing MTSS and Tiered interventions
Develop, schedule and facilitate Behavior trainings and Professional Development for Behavior Team and other KIPP teams (i.e. schools, cohorts, regional teams, etc.)

Trauma-Informed & Preventative Practices

Works closely and collaboratively with Mental Health Leadership team members to ensure alignment across department roles
Supports the implementation of HEART (Healing Environments And Responses to Trauma) initiative at KIPP SoCal Public Schools, particularly Tier 1 interventions: Implementation of Calm Classroom (mindfulness) across schools; Establishment of Calm Corners across schools; Integration of Social and Emotional Learning within classrooms (e.g. Ripple Effects, Quaver SEL); Positive Behavior Interventions & Supports
Recommends and teaches techniques for supporting students’ social and emotional & behavioral needs
Subject matter expert for trauma-informed/culturally responsive behavioral interventions & SSPTs
Supports School Psychologists in providing consultation and recommendations for designated schools’ SSPT process
Co-leads support meetings and training for SSPT Leads at schools

Qualifications

Qualifications

BCBA License, required
Bachelor’s degree, required
Master degree in Behavioral Sciences, ABA or related field, required
Minimum 3 years of management experience of school based team members, required
PPSC (Pupil Personnel Services Credential) or Teaching Credential , preferred
Minimum 8 years post-Master’s degree

Cultural awareness and agility, and ability to foster trust, communication, and culture change

Superb organizational, planning, and implementation skills
Ability to manage the ambiguity and multiple priorities
Ability to communicate and interact effectively with multiple stakeholders
Excellent written, communication, and public skills
High proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word
Initiative, innovation, advocacy, leadership, resilience, and tenacity
Experience managing and developing school behavior professionals
Experience leading/advising complex and/or cross-functional projects and teams
Able to stay positive through challenges
Comfort driving between schools across Los Angeles (including San Diego and SoCal)
Detail-oriented team player willing to roll up sleeves and get the job done
Unquestioned integrity and commitment to KIPP SoCal Public Schools mission and community
Willingness to go above and beyond to drive the success of a dynamic team committed to a new future for urban education

Additional Information

Joining KIPP SoCal Means the Following

Working at an organization committed to the hard work necessary to ensure education is for liberation
Support and care from fellow regional team members
Ongoing professional development and coaching from manager

new_jobs.title: Information Security Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Role purpose

The Information Security Project Manager is responsible for coordinating and driving the company’s information security activities in a pragmatic, commercially aware way.
This role exists to manage security-related projects, audits, and customer security interactions so that we stay compliant and credible without blocking sensible business decisions or over-engineering controls.

Scope and context

This role sits within the technology function and partners closely with Technical Operations, Engineering, Product, Legal, and Sales.
The focus is on governance, coordination, and communication
, not on dictating policy in isolation or acting as the final decision-maker on security matters.
Final risk and tooling decisions sit with the Director of Technical Operations and the broader leadership team; the Information Security Project Manager’s job is to provide clear input, well-reasoned recommendations, and organised execution.
We are a growing SaaS business without PCI, PHI, or highly sensitive PII in scope, and we are not subject to HIPAA or classified/secret information regime – our security approach should be proportionate: strong, credible, and well-documented, but not theatrical or unnecessarily restrictive.

Key responsibilities

ISO 27001 and internal audits

Plan, coordinate, and execute internal audits and control reviews against ISO 27001 (and related frameworks where relevant).
Maintain audit schedules, evidence repositories, and action logs so that we are consistently “audit ready” rather than scrambling before assessments.
Work with control owners across the business to ensure that required processes are in place, understood, and operating in a pragmatic way.
Track findings and remediation actions, ensuring owners are clear on what needs to be done and by when, and following up to completion.
Support external ISO 27001 surveillance and recertification audits, including planning, evidence collation, and managing auditor queries.

Security projects and initiatives

Coordinate discrete security improvement projects (for example, rolling out new security tooling, tightening access controls, or updating key policies).
Break down security initiatives into clear tasks, owners, and timelines, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.
Work with Technical Operations and Engineering to ensure technical changes are understood, documented, and reflected in our security posture.
Help prioritise security work by articulating risk, impact, and effort, while understanding the wider commercial and delivery context.

Customer security, RFPs and RFQs

Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success to respond to customer security questionnaires, RFPs, RFQs, and due diligence requests.
Maintain and continuously improve a central library of standard security responses and artefacts (for example, summaries of our controls, certifications, and processes).
Coordinate input from Technical Operations, Engineering, and Legal where deeper technical or contractual responses are required.
Attend customer calls when needed to explain our security posture in clear, non-alarmist language and build confidence in our approach.

Security information and communication

Develop and maintain a clear, concise view of our security posture that can be communicated internally and to customers (for example, how we handle data, access, monitoring, and incident response at a high level).
Ensure that key facts (such as use of encryption at rest and in transit, SSO capabilities, backup approaches, and incident processes) are understood and kept up to date, even if technical details are owned by others.
Translate technical explanations from engineers into language suitable for non-technical audiences, including customers and internal stakeholders.
Help ensure that security-related messages are proportionate, avoiding both complacency and unnecessary drama.

Policies, standards, and pragmatic governance

Maintain a focused, manageable set of security policies and procedures that reflect how we actually operate.
Work with policy owners to keep documents current, usable, and aligned to ISO 27001 and customer expectations, avoiding policy sprawl and unnecessary complexity.
Coordinate periodic reviews of key policies and standards, ensuring changes are communicated and understood.
Provide recommendations to the Director of Technical Operations on improvements to policies, controls, or tooling, with clear reasoning and trade-offs.

What this role is not

This is not a “head of security” or ultimate decision-maker role; final go/no-go and tooling decisions sit with the Director of Technical Operations and leadership.
This is not a role for writing endless policies or blocking change; it is about enabling sensible decisions with good information and structured follow-through.
This is not a hands-on security engineering or development role, though you will need enough technical understanding to ask good questions and interpret answers.
This is not an internal “police” function; success is based on collaboration, influence, and clarity, not on authority.

What You'll Bring To The Role

We’re looking for someone who brings most of the following:
3–5 years of experience in information security, compliance, risk, or IT audit within a SaaS or technology environment.
Hands-on experience with ISO 27001 (or similar frameworks), including audits, evidence collection, and remediation tracking.
Solid project management skills — planning, tracking progress, managing stakeholders, and communicating clearly.
Working knowledge of core security concepts such as encryption (at rest/in transit), access control, SSO/identity providers, backup and recovery, logging, and incident response — enough to discuss confidently and know when to bring in a specialist.
Comfortable engaging directly with customers and auditors, answering questions calmly and credibly.
Strong writing skills for policies, reports, and customer communications, paired with clear verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

Personal qualities

Pragmatic and commercially aware: able to distinguish between theoretical risk and real-world impact.
Collaborative, working with teams to find workable solutions rather than simply saying “no”.
Organised and methodical, keeping track of multiple audits, projects, and requests without dropping details.
Calm and credible under pressure, especially during audits, customer escalations, or security-related incidents.
Comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, and highlighting risk while still respecting broader business priorities.

Why this role matters

Done well, this role gives the business confidence that our security posture is robust, evidenced, and well-articulated, without turning security into a blocker for growth.
It ensures we meet our obligations to customers and auditors, support sales with clear and honest answers, and make security improvements in a deliberate, organised, and commercially sensible way.

Why us?

Perks & Benefits

Remote & flexible working – with hybrid options in London or Chichester
Fantastic team culture based on trust and belonging.
Laptop & home office budget – 500 EUR to set up your ideal workspace.
Private Medical Insurance with Aviva, including Dental & Optical.
Group Life Insurance & Yulife Wellbeing & Rewards.
Mental well-being support – Access therapy, mental health sessions, and yoga through a free premium subscription to Headspace.
EAP confidential benefit – 24/7 access to compassionate guidance & expert advice
25 days holiday + bank holidays
Training, support, and personal development

Gérer des projets multidisciplinaires en hydroélectricité et en barrages;

Baccalauréat en génie civil, structure ou géotechnique;
Expérience à titre de réviseur(se) principal(e) sur des projets en hydroélectricité et barrages;
Minimum de 12 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets et solide réseau dans le secteur de l’hydroélectricité et des barrages, idéalement en Ontario et/ou dans le Canada atlantique;
Expérience marquée en gestion de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires;
Excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite;
Capacité à planifier, organiser et prioriser le travail, et à travailler efficacement en équipe;
Initiative, proactivité, autonomie et grand souci du détail;
Capacité à respecter les échéanciers et à gérer efficacement plusieurs tâches en parallèle;

Approche proactive en résolution de problèmes et solides compétences en prise de décision.

Pourquoi choisir WSP?

Nous existons pour façonner des communautés et faire progresser l’humanité. Les ingénieurs, conseillers et scientifiques les plus brillants du monde entier font de WSP leur maison.

Fièrement canadienne – nous faisons partie des 100 meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026

Des possibilités illimitées commencent ici. Que ce soit à travers le pays ou à l’échelle mondiale, nous vous aiderons à adapter votre rôle à vos ambitions — parce que votre croissance alimente la nôtre

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Outform Group, our guiding philosophy is Dare To Innovate.

Outform Group specializes in creating tangible consumer engagements that elevate, connect and humanize brand experiences. We unite leading experts in research, strategy, design, innovation and manufacturing, who work together to create unforgettable brand experiences.

Lean, interdisciplinary teams work in close collaboration with clients, helping them to solve their user’s biggest problems. Our user-centric, data-driven approach focuses on creating a seamless experience across different environments.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager
to own and drive complex, high‑visibility technology initiatives from concept through global deployment.

This role requires a seasoned technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, navigates complexity with ease, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to deeply understand technologies that power modern retail experiences. Curiosity, technical breadth, and strong execution discipline are essential.

DIRECT REPORTS

None

SCOPE & ACCOUNTABILITY

This role owns the full lifecycle of complex, high-visibility technology programs—from initial scoping and architecture through global deployment and long-term support. The Senior Technical Project Manager serves as the central technical authority and primary client-facing leader for large-scale retail technology initiatives, with initial focus on multi-phase LED video wall programs for a major retail brand. This position carries direct accountability for program outcomes across scope, timeline, budget, and quality, while simultaneously building and maintaining high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones. The role operates with significant autonomy and is expected to make high-impact decisions that shape both client experience and internal capability.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Oversight

Provide senior-level oversight across multiple concurrent technology programs, ensuring technical feasibility, design excellence, and flawless execution within scope, timeline, and budget.
Evaluate project opportunities, define high-level architecture, determine resource needs, and guide teams through complex decision-making.
Lead the development and integration of hardware, software, and physical display systems, ensuring seamless performance in demanding retail environments.
Build and maintain high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones.
Define technical requirements, develop comprehensive technology BOMs, and guide sourcing, procurement, and estimation strategies.

Program & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, translating their goals into actionable technical plans and delivering executive-level communication.
Oversee large-scale project roadmaps, risk mitigation strategies, and milestone tracking across multiple parallel workstreams.
Maintain and evolve technical documentation, including wiring schematics, integration maps, digital die lines, and BOMs.
Define and implement documentation standards, QA processes, and best practices for installation, support, and troubleshooting.
Lead internal and external status meetings, delivering clear updates to senior stakeholders.

Hands-On Technical Execution

Personally evaluate, test, and validate technology solutions as part of pre-sale exploration, prototyping, and client demonstrations.
Build quick-turn prototypes and technology demos that support new business development and innovation initiatives.
Act as a tier-two escalation point for complex troubleshooting, ensuring issues are resolved swiftly and root causes are understood.
Partner with technology vendors to scope, assess, and co-develop solutions tailored for retail activation.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

Operate as the central hub between engineering, design, production, sourcing, and client teams—translating technical details into clear, actionable insights.
Foster an inclusive and collaborative environment that encourages experimentation, knowledge sharing, and creative problem-solving.
Anticipate communication gaps and proactively bridge them across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to scaling technical project management capabilities across the organization.

KEY INTERFACES (NON-REPORTING)

This role collaborates consistently with the following teams and functions outside its direct reporting structure: Engineering and Software Development teams (hardware/software integration), Design and Creative teams (retail experience and display design), Production and Fabrication teams (manufacturing and physical build), Sourcing and Procurement teams (vendor and component management), Client stakeholders and executive sponsors, Technology Vendors and LED/digital signage suppliers, Global Manufacturing Partners (including production facilities in China), and Installation and Field Support teams.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Success in this role will be measured against metrics including but not limited to:

On-time and on-budget delivery rate across assigned technology programs
Client satisfaction scores and retention on managed accounts
Prototype and demo quality as measured by client approval and conversion
Speed and effectiveness of issue resolution (escalation response time)
Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation (BOMs, schematics, integration maps)
Cross-functional team feedback on communication clarity and collaboration
Adherence to QA standards and reduction in post-installation defects

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field preferred; equivalent work experience accepted. Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in a technical project management role within experiential, retail, hardware, software, or systems integration environments.

Technical Knowledge

Strong foundation in both hardware and software systems with ability to engage in deep technical discussions
Prior experience with LED systems, digital signage, and retail technology highly preferred
Familiarity with wiring schematics, integration maps, and technology BOMs
Hands-on technical aptitude (e.g., PC building, coding, home networking, video editing, or interactive technology tinkering)

Program Management Skills

Proven track record managing large, multi-stakeholder programs with competing priorities
Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation, QA processes, and installation standards
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

Communication & Leadership

Exceptional communication and leadership presence with demonstrated client-facing skills
Ability to translate complex technical information for non-technical audiences
Experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders

Other Requirements

Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time (domestic and international, including China)
Availability for weekly calls with teams in China across time zones

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES & PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

Strategic & Innovative Thinker: Approaches problems with a forward-thinking mindset, comfortable owning high-impact decisions and operating with autonomy in ambiguous situations.

Exceptional Communicator: Able to simplify technical complexity for any audience—from engineers to C-suite executives—with clarity, confidence, and precision.

Trust Builder: Earns credibility through deep preparation, technical intelligence, and consistent execution. Develops high-trust relationships with clients, vendors, and internal teams alike.

Relentless Problem Solver: Thrives under pressure with a track record of delivering results. Approaches obstacles with a solutions-oriented mindset and never leaves an issue unresolved.

Collaborative Influencer: Skilled at guiding cross-functional decisions and rallying diverse teams behind a shared goal without formal authority.

Passionate About Retail Technology: Genuinely energized by leveraging technology to create best-in-class customer experiences in physical retail environments.

Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented: Consistently meets deadlines, maintains rigorous documentation standards, and keeps complex programs on track simultaneously.

Self-Driven & Proactive: Takes initiative without being prompted, anticipates needs before they arise, and is energized by building what doesn’t yet exist.

Positive Can-Do Attitude: Willing to jump in wherever and whenever needed, bringing energy and optimism to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Essential Functions

Working conditions are in a normal office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk, sit, and stand, using hands to handle, finger, or feel objects, tools, or controls. Occasionally, the employee must crouch or kneel. The employee must occasionally exert or lift up to 20 pounds. Successful performance requires good eyesight with or without corrective lenses. Requires long periods of time working at a computer and includes phone work. Travel up to 30% of the time is required and is an essential function of this position.

About the company

As product compliance and ESG regulations continue to expand worldwide, and consumers increasingly demand sustainable, eco-friendly products, companies struggle to collect, validate, and report supply chain data to meet due diligence and compliance obligations – particularly when sourcing materials and commodities from around the world. 

Source Intelligence is the culmination of five trailblazers in ESG and compliance solution development who combined their expertise and technology to deliver the most comprehensive solution on the market. We empower our clients to identify and eliminate environmental hazards and human rights abuses in their supply chains through unmatched innovation, reliability, and expertise. Our industry-leading solutions – from SaaS software to fully managed services – are designed to meet each client’s unique needs and evolve alongside them throughout their compliance journey.  

By partnering with Source Intelligence, companies gain deeper insight into their supply chain, enabling them to make better sourcing, design, and packaging decisions for the benefit of people and the planet. 

About the role  

A background in engineering, chemical management, or a product/data/configuration manager with experience in product design lifecycle and regulatory compliance is desired and would ideally be suited to a platform subject matter expert.  However, we encourage you to apply if you're excited about this role even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align.  
ResponsibilitiesWhat we’re looking for
2+ years in the high-tech industry having held roles such as Project Manager, Sales Engineer/Architect, etc. 
Experience with ERP/PLM systems such as PTC Windchill, Teamcenter, Oracle Agile or SAP PLM. 
Experience of SaaS software implementation, support and data management. 
Technically able to quickly learn the compliance platform and how it can be implemented successfully. 
Have a proactive attitude to planning, scheduling resource and monitoring performance against deadlines and milestones, working with stakeholders to define expected benefits and to create plans for their realization. 
Can form strong relationships with key stakeholders both internally and externally with the ability to see both the wider picture and detailed subject matter.  
Create and obtain sign-off on project plans, keeping them regularly updated during the project delivery.   
Be able to identify and manage risks and issues throughout the life of a project, product or service. 
Organization and planning for all platform changes such as security and platform upgrades for a Project, Product or Service. 
Be Customer focused, understanding your key customers’ strategies for adoption of Source Intelligence technologies and developing programs to enable a success and provide a feedback loop on our products and the competitive landscape ensuring that your customers’ requirements are being met within our product through partnership with the Product Management Team.  
Promotes ideas on behalf of self or others encouraging collaborative knowledge sharing with flexibility and      adaptability to achieve successful outcomes. 
Deliver expected outputs to high-quality standards and ensure that any type of change relating to the project, is managed and communicated in accordance with company standards. 
A strong team player with effective communication and interpersonal skills with excellent written and spoken English. 
Take initiative with confidence and ability to work under own direction with an organized mindset, demonstrating the ability for complex decision making and critical thinking. 
Work with the team to enhance documentation, record videos, contribute knowledge base articles, and create other public and internal enablement material. 
Creative in solving Customer Adoption Challenges.

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.

Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

We are Flink - your online supermarket revolutionising the way you do your grocery shopping. With a wide selection of over 2,400 high-quality products, we aim to deliver to your door in minutes. Founded by experienced e-commerce professionals and seasoned entrepreneurs with exceptional track records, backed by some of the most renowned Global investors, we are growing rapidly and have a great hunger to continuously challenge ourselves. We pride ourselves in being an inclusive and equal opportunities employer with a diverse and multicultural team.

If you want to be part of this exciting journey… read on!

In your role as Business Operations Analyst (m/f/d)
you will be critical in the continued success of our marketplace partnerships. With our ambitious growth targets set for 2027, our marketplace partnerships play a crucial role, and understanding performance to better forecast success will be a key part of this role.

Job Description

Performance Analysis: Drive the analysis of performance across all marketplaces. This is more than just analyzing data! It’s deriving the business impact and driving initiatives that solve the problems.
Troubleshoot and Resolve: Act as the first line of defense for any operational issues that arise. You'll separate the real problems from the noise, solve problems or route them to the right people internally or with the partner, until they're solved.
Automate and Innovate: Leverage your skills to build, maintain, and improve scripts and tools that automate repetitive operational tasks, such as catalog updates and hub availability checks, reducing manual effort and eliminating errors.
Collaborate Across a Global Stage: Work hand-in-hand with internal teams (Commercial, Tech, and Operations) and external marketplace partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and execute strategic projects.
Experimentation: Run commercial experiments aimed at measurable growth across the marketplaces from setup through to the read-out. You'll help size the opportunity, track the test, and make an honest call on whether it worked.

Qualifications

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Computer Science, or a related field.
Clear experience in Data Analysis: You work day-to-day with SQL and have strong experience in turning data analysis into actionable insights, demonstrable through initiatives you have led.
Proficiency with BI Tooling: You have a solid experience with tools such as PowerBI/Looker (2+ years), comfortable with turning requests into insightful insights
Automation track record: You have not just played around with automating processes, but have clear examples of taking manual inefficiencies and building clean, working automation with your AI tool of choice.
Excellent Communication: Full professional fluency in English (both written and verbal) is required to collaborate effectively with our international team and partners.

new_jobs.title: Operational Readiness Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
CAI Overview:

Are You Ready?

CAI is a professional services company established in 1996 that has grown to over 700 people worldwide. We provide program and project management, commissioning, qualification, validation, start-up, and other consulting services associated with operational readiness and operational excellence to FDA-regulated and other mission-critical industries.

We put our clients’ interests first, we do not stop until it is right, and we will do whatever it takes to get there.

At CAI, we are committed to living our Foundational Principles:

We act with integrity

We Serve Each Other

We serve society

We work for our future

We believe that with employee ownership, one person’s success is everyone’s success. We embrace a Team Before Self
mindset, demonstrate Respect for Others
, and maintain a Can-Do Attitude
—our three core values.

Position Overview:

The Operational Readiness Project Manager (ORPM) serves as a strategic leader bridging the gap between mechanical completion and sustained operational performance. The ORPM designs and leads holistic Operational Readiness programs using CAI’s six-pillar Readiness Framework. This role ensures project teams achieve right-first-time metrics, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and deliver world-class performance from day one.

Key Responsibilities:

Project & Program Leadership
Lead project teams to achieve Operational Readiness (OR) objectives.
Manage readiness-to-operations lifecycle for 1–3 client engagements simultaneously.
Drive on-time, on-scope delivery of readiness programs.
Pillar Integration & Execution
Serve as the primary consultant for OR campaigns integrating with Quality, Process, and Workforce streams.
Apply OE principles to pre-Day One activities (e.g., visual management, accountability, problem-solving).
Client Advisory
Act as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders (VPs, Site Heads, etc.).
Guide decision-making with a risk-based, speed-to-value mindset.
People Development
Lead and coach cross-functional teams including CQV, Quality, and external contractors.
Cultivate a culture of feedback and growth.
Thought Leadership
Contribute to CAI's brand via white papers, conference presentations, and client tools.

Skills & Characteristics Required:

Consulting & Facilitation
Align project stakeholders with clear vision and measurable goals.
Expert-level guidance for site and department leadership.
Project Execution
Manage scheduling, resource loading, controls, and closeout.
Execute comprehensive project planning and delivery.
Continuous Improvement
Drive site-wide transformation using Lean, Six Sigma, or TPM methodologies.

Qualifications and Experience:

BS or MS in a relevant science or engineering field (or equivalent).
3+ years as a program/project manager on life science projects ($1MM+), or
8+ years in GMP-regulated operations with 5+ years leading readiness/start-up/OE transformations.

(Black Belt or equivalent preferred.)

Proven multi-site or multi-client portfolio experience.
Deep understanding of quality systems, tech transfer, equipment qualification, and analytics.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficient in project management software tools.

Other Requirements:

Excellent written and verbal English communication.
Able to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.
Domestic and international travel may be required.
Willing to work overtime when necessary.
PMI PMP or PgMP certification a plus.

Critical Competencies

Influence Strategy

Evaluates and pursues initiatives, opportunities, and priorities based on fit with organization strategies.
Identifies innovative solutions to challenges that have strategic impact, balancing both short- and long-term concerns.
Identifies issues related to emerging customer and market needs.

Satisfy the Customer

Identifies and anticipates customer requirements, expectations, and needs.
Develops solutions that meet or exceed customer expectations and shares feedback with relevant groups.
Consistently follows up with customers to resolve issues and maintain customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Continually searches for ways to improve customer service, including removal of barriers and providing solutions.

Plan for Success

Translates business/function strategies into aligned plans and objectives and integrates across business groups.
Obtains and allocates resources needed to accomplish goals.
Anticipates risk and builds effective contingency plans.

Pursue Execution

Prioritizes and balances time, actions, resources, and initiatives to ensure achievement of critical goals.
Holds self and others accountable for achieving outcomes.
Anticipates obstacles and takes appropriate actions to accelerate work or improve quality.

Tailor Communication

Communicates information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
Tailors communication style and content to audience effectively.
Writes technical concepts clearly and thoroughly for all audience types.

Build Partnerships

Cultivates a network of people across a variety of disciplines and functions within the organization.
Builds collaboration by identifying and conveying common interests and priorities, removing barriers, and breaking down silos.
Appropriately involves others in decisions and plans that affect them.
Maintains positive relationships regardless of challenges, organizational level, personality, or background differences.

Influence Others

Develops and articulates compelling rationale for positions.
Builds a broad base of support among key decision makers and influencers.
Positions and explains ideas and proposals in ways that get support from others.
Encourages others to find new solutions that improve outcomes and deliver value.

Develop Self And Others

Continuously develops interpersonal skills to build effective internal and external relationships.
Models company values and always acts with integrity.
Looks for opportunities to develop breakthrough ideas and initiatives.

We are an equal opportunity employer; we are proud to employ veterans and promote diversity and inclusion in our workplace. Diversity is a strength for our global company. We pledge that CAI will be operated in a way that is fair and equitable to all – our employees, our customers, and the broader society.

This job description is not all inclusive and you may be asked to do other duties. CAI will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Chance Act (FCA) / Fair Chance Ordinance (FCO).

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Average base salary range - not including benefits, and potential overtime and/or Cost of Living Adjustment.

CAI Benefits:

Comprehensive Health Insurance coverage
24 days of Paid Time Off
Company paid Life Insurance
Company paid Long Term Disability

The Enterprise Applications Project Manager has primary responsibilities in two key areas: the management of technology projects and the support and enhancement of various enterprise applications. In the area of project management, this position is responsible for the design and development of the project management and change leadership strategy, process, and culture, initially for the Enterprise Applications Team and eventually for all of ITS. With respect to enterprise applications, this position manages the full systems life cycle for University ERP, SIS, CRM, and many other mission-critical applications. The incumbent will play a key role in developing and executing the university’s digital transformation strategy. Must be able to support and promote the University’s Mission.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Lead the advancement of a project management structured approach for enterprise systems and technology initiatives within ITS and when called upon outside ITS by developing a right sized, repeatable, and sustainable strategy. This includes developing and deploying project management tools, techniques, templates, and documentation standards to maintain organization, effectiveness and efficiency managing projects.

Works to establish a culture of project management, change management, and continuous improvement. Lead, mentor, share resources, and provide training opportunities for others.Demonstrate the value of a structure approach and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.

Help drive strategic initiatives by working with the Enterprise Applications Team, departments, and stakeholders on solutions and eliminating roadblocks in enterprise systems. This includes leading complex and high-risk evaluation, implementation, and migration projects working closely with third-party vendors, providers, and consultants.

Manages and supports the technical environment of various enterprise systems to ensure systems are up to date, performing efficiently, secure, and utilized effectively.Configures and administers interfaces, integrations, processes, reports, and dashboards to provide an improved user experience and empower data driven decision making.

Supports data governance initiatives working with departments, data stewards and business analysts. Communicates potential concerns, researches, and provides recommendations and solutions. Strives to ensure that new software being evaluated or implemented meets data governance standards.

Participates in ITS department leadership and decision-making. Performs other duties as assigned within the scope and responsibility and requirements of the position.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Enterprise Application Manager may supervise Systems Analysts and other staff assigned to his/her unit and will be responsible for their performance evaluations. This position will also provide oversight, guidance, and direction to all sub-contractors or vendors working on Enterprise Applications to ensure university objectives are being met.

CONTACT WITH OTHERS:

Internal : Extensive; will have frequent interactions with University faculty, administrators, and staff; occasional interaction with students
External : Vendors, sub-contractors, consultants

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education : Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree with major course work in MIS, Engineering, or a related field is required. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) certification(s) preferred.

Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to communicate clearly with individual computer users on all levels; in small groups, one on one, and in writing.
Strong project management mentality, ability to successfully manage multiple tasks at any given point, able to complete assigned tasks with speed and accuracy according to predetermined timelines

Grace, established in 1854, is a Standard Industries company and a leading global supplier of specialty chemicals and solutions that enable industries to enhance modern life.
